question.text: Foreign contributions received by an NPO in India are regulated under FCRA 2010, administered by which Ministry?

answer.text: Ministry of Finance, Department of Economic Affairs
Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) — NPOs must register under FCRA to accept foreign donations

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Ch 1.8.1 (B), the Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) regulates NPOs receiving foreign contributions under FCRA 2010. NPOs must register under FCRA to accept foreign donations. The Trap: Option A (MCA) regulates Section 8 Companies but not FCRA. Option B (MoF) regulates banking/capital markets. Option D (MEA) is foreign-policy-facing, not FCRA administrator. Cross-Exam Context: Cross-links to XXIV / IFSCA-01 (AML) where FCRA overlaps with foreign-inflow monitoring, and Ch 11 (Key Regulations). SIAs must verify FCRA registration and filings (FC-4) where foreign contribution is part of the funding stack. Assessor's Pro-Tip: Request the latest FC-4 (annual return) filing, FCRA registration certificate, and the designated FCRA bank account statement (SBI New Delhi Main Branch is mandatory). Foreign contribution commingling with domestic funds is a red flag — escalate via management letter.
